newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds higher on U.S. data, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds higher on U.S. data, seen rising.

text.p: 1610 GMT - Austrian bonds end the week on a buoyant note after latest batch of U.S. indicators hints at healthy growth and subdued inflation.
"The U.S. data gave us the final push," said one trader, adding that most market participants expected further advances over the coming week.
* 10-year benchmark 5.75 pct bond maturing July 2006 up 40 bps at 99.95 to yield 5.75 (5.81) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 100.30/40 to yield 5.71/69 pct.
* Five-year 4.625 bond maturing May 2002 up ten bps at 99.55 to yield 4.73 (4.75) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.68/78 to yield 4.70/67 percent.
* Austrian bond future up 31 bps at 108.74 on turnover of 542 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany steady at two bps, five-year spread down one at 18 bps.
* Money market rates steady with three-month VIBOR at 3.400 and overnight money at 3.09/3.34. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 256
